text: Gomɗii Men nulii ado maa an Nulaaɗo, Nulaaɓe goo, haa e mofte maɓɓe ɗen, ɓe addani ɓe hujjaaji ɓannginɗi gonnga maɓɓe kan, kono ɓeya fenni ɓe. Men yottii ontuma e ɓen faggitiiɓe geddi, Men halkiri ɓe lepte Amen ɗen, Men daɗndi Nulaaɓe ɓen e gomɗimɓe wondunooɓe e maɓɓe ɓen. Daɗndugol gomɗime ɓen, faaboo ɓe, ko ko Men waɗɗini e Amen.
